title: Marriage to Catherine and other band weddings
summary: Cootie married Catherine after joining Duke; they discuss when Hodges and Chick Webb married.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: You haven't told me when you and Catherine married.
Oh. Well, then, did you get married before you went with Duke?
No. I think we got married after I went with Duke.
Oh. I see. Well, that's good. So -- and did you -- did Johnny marry too, about that same time?
Yeah. Right. When -- well, when did Chick get married? Do you remember?
He wasn't married when you were with him then?
No. He didn't get married until late. Until after Ella was with him and he got rolling good.
Oh, yeah. And things looked a little--
Yeah. That's when he got married.
